vice.text: Doubtless there exists in this world precisely the right woman for any given man to marry and vice versa; but when you consider that a human being has the opportunity of being acquainted with only a few hundred people, and out of the few hundred that there are but a dozen or less whom he knows intimately, and out of the dozen, one or two friends at most, it will easily be seen, when we remember the number of millions who inhabit this world, that probably, since the earth was created, the right man has never yet met the right woman.
vice.textCn: 毫無疑問，世上存在這樣的情況：無論哪個男人，都有一個完全合適的女人與他結婚，反之亦然。然而，試想人一生中只有機會認識幾百個人，而在這幾百人中只能真正了解不到十幾個人，再從這十幾個人中只能和一兩個人成為朋友，而且如果我們所記得的也只是這世上的幾百萬人——那麼你很容易就能察覺到：自地球誕生以來，那個完全合適的男人，也許從未遇見過那個完全合適的女人。
